shared_elements: anthropomorphic face with large eyes and nose
headdress or covering over the head
schematic bulging eye rendered as an incised oval
justification: Both depict an anthropomorphic face with heavy schematic features and both use incised cross-hatched/net-like patterning on an adjoining element (a head covering in A, woven costume elements in B), which is the most specific overlap. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A is a single massive head in the round with no accompanying figures or scene, while B is a flat panel showing a complete standing figure in elaborate regalia with subsidiary elements flanking and below it.
